# STOP -- Do not file security issues here

If you have found a security vulnerability in Walter-OS, **please follow the private disclosure process** in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).

This template exists only so the "New issue" UI does not show "Security" as an empty/missing category.

Public security issues will be **closed immediately** and the operator will reach out via the private channel.

For non-vulnerability security questions (e.g., "how do I configure X securely"), use the **Question / support** template with category `-SECURITY-` instead.
